capabilities: Sync files and folders bidirectionally with a GitHub repository folder
Sync or pull the currently edited file via a sync menu
Batch-initialize or force-sync the whole vault with a remote
Upload pasted images to cloud storage and insert CDN links
Cache file status and show sync status in the status bar
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The README warns that force sync overwrites existing files and that GitHub API rate limits apply (5000 requests/hour authenticated).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync only a specific folder with GitHub, sync single files on demand, or replace pasted images with cloud-hosted links.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that supports synchronization with GitHub repositories

requires.name: GitHub account with a personal access token
Cloud storage credentials (Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, AWS S3, or Cloudflare R2)

summary: Syncs vault files or folders with a chosen folder in a GitHub repository and optionally uploads pasted images to cloud storage.
